detail.longDescription: 📜 The Byzantine Generals Problem [1982] By: Leslie Lamport, Robert Shostak, Marshall Pease The paper "The Byzantine Generals Problem" by Lamport, Shostak, and Pease addresses a critical issue in distributed computing systems, where some components may fail and provide inconsistent information to different parts of the system. 📖 http://www. andrew.cmu.edu/course/15-749/R EADINGS/required/resilience/lamport82.pdf # paperswelove # research # compsci
